title: Role of acidity in acid-clay catalysts for the phosgene-free synthesis of methylene diphenyl dicarbamate (MDC)
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12927-12933
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09318J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pengfei Chen, Junfeng Qian, Qun Chen, Xuan Dai, Mingyang He
The phosgene-free synthesis of methylene diphenyl diisocyanate (MDI) from dimethyl carbonate (DMC) involves the acid-catalyzed condensation of methyl N-phenylcarbamate (MPC) with formaldehyde (HCHO) to produce methylene diphenyl carbamate (MDC).
